name: root-rise
description: Read a Root & Rise plant issue and return Ember’s advice to that plant’s journal.

interface.longDescription: Help Jess understand a plant concern using her description and attached photo, then save advice back to the exact Root & Rise request. Request-scoped permissions expire after seven days. No care dates or watering records are changed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help with this Root & Rise plant request and return your advice to its journal.
